# Choros

> Choros (CHOROS.IO LIMITED, company no. 16014661) is a software, AI-implementation and marketing company in Carmarthen, Wales, working with established UK businesses. Fixed scope, fixed price; the client owns the code. The AI Operations Audit is from £4,950, delivered in two weeks. Contact: team@choros.io, 07494 913569.

## Services
- [AI Implementation](https://choros.io/ai-implementation/): A fixed-price AI Operations Audit, from £4,950 and delivered in two weeks, shows where AI and automation would pay for themselves. Then we build what pays.
- [The AI Operations Audit](https://choros.io/ai-operations-audit/): A two-week, fixed-price review of where AI and automation would pay for themselves in your business, from £4,950. Fee credited if you build with us.
- [Software Development](https://choros.io/software-development/): Bespoke platforms, internal tools and integrations for UK businesses. Fixed scope, fixed price, you own the code. Send us the quote you have been given.
- [Marketing](https://choros.io/marketing/): Google Ads, Meta Ads, local SEO and the CRM behind them, for showrooms, trades and hospitality across the UK. From the team that runs besttrades.wales.

## Marketing sectors
- [Kitchen & Bathroom Showrooms](https://choros.io/marketing/kitchen-bathroom-showrooms/): Google Ads, Meta Ads, local SEO and instant follow-up that turn local searches into booked design consultations for UK kitchen and bathroom showrooms.
- [Home Services & Trades](https://choros.io/marketing/home-services-trades/): Google Ads, local SEO, review generation and instant enquiry follow-up for UK trade businesses, from the team that built besttrades.wales.
- [Restaurants & Hospitality](https://choros.io/marketing/restaurants-hospitality/): Covers on quiet nights, bookings instead of likes: Google, Meta, local SEO and automated follow-up for UK restaurants, bars and hospitality venues.

## Work
- [Our work](https://choros.io/work/): A client platform quoted at £1M and built in four months for about a tenth, plus besttrades.wales and the Instant Website Builder, which we run ourselves.
- [HedgePoint](https://choros.io/work/hedgepoint/): An FX treasury risk platform quoted at £1M and 18 months elsewhere, delivered in four months for about a tenth. Built, secured and still run by Choros.
